Definition:
Logical model for the revised Nigeria HIV Pharmacy Daily Worksheet. One
instance represents one pharmacist worksheet for one dispensing date and
contains repeatable patient-level dispensing entries corresponding to
printed fields W1 through W73.
Identifier assigned to the Pharmacy Daily Worksheet instance.
Continuous worksheet number. The supporting SOP permits a pharmacist-specific alphabetical suffix in facilities with multiple dispensing points.
Reference to the dispensing facility, when available.
State where the dispensing facility is located.
Local Government Area where the dispensing facility is located.
Official name of the dispensing facility.
Date on which medicines were dispensed and recorded on this worksheet.
One patient-level row in the Pharmacy Daily Worksheet. The printed page provides fifteen rows.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Sequential number assigned to the patient row.

Patient name recorded surname first.

Definition: True when the female-pregnant column is marked. Female non-pregnant is represented by female sex with pregnant set to false.

Definition: Client age in completed years.
Facility-based or community-based differentiated-service-delivery model.
True when ART was initiated at the dispensing visit.
True for ART refill, including transfer-in and restart.
True when a drug was replaced because of toxicity, side effect or another substitution reason.
True when the client changed between ART regimen lines.

Short: W15 HEI newly started on ARV prophylaxis
Definition: True when an HIV-exposed infant initiated ARV prophylaxis.
True when an HIV-exposed infant received a prophylaxis refill.
Printed prophylaxis code 1, 2 or 3.
True when ARVs were dispensed for occupational HIV exposure.
True when ARVs were dispensed for non-occupational HIV exposure.
True when a client was newly initiated on PrEP.
True when a client received a PrEP refill.
True when pharmaceutical care was provided during the visit.
Current ART regimen code.
Source regimen text when a valid ART register code is unavailable.
A quantity recorded under one of the fixed medicine-product columns.
